player_prompt.intro:
O Player {player_id} mo Kheleng ya Tshwaro.
O na le dithoto tse di kgonegang, mokgwa wa gago ke go tshwara gore tolomorothele ya dithoto tsa gago e kgonege.
Dithoto le madi a sone a gago a bontsi jono ke:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Ka ngwaga le ngwaga, o ka kgobelela le motho wa gago wa kheleng le go dira tshwaro.
Dirisana le ditshwanelo tse di kgethegileng tsa tsebe:
  - '[Tshwaro: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Tshwaro: Dithoto tse di oferweng -> Dithoto tse di hlatlogwang]
  - '[Accept]': Go amogelela tshwaro e e tsenegang.
  - '[Deny]': Go tlola tshwaro e e tsenegang (selegae).
Khelo e tswelela ka {max_turns} diphofo go feta.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Motshameki o ne a leka go amogela kgwebo e nngwe ntle le gore a nne le didirisiwa tse di tlhokegang.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Tsebe ya tsotlhe. Kolomiti {col} e kwa ntle ga mafelo.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Tsebe ya tsotlhe. Kolomiti {col} e fedile.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Motshameki {player_id} o ne a leka go dira tshitshinyo ya kgwebo ntle le gore e nne ene yo o nang le didiriswa tse di tlhokegang.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Motshameki {player_id} o ne a dira tshitshinyo ya go rekisa ka tsela e e sa siamang.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Motshameki {player_id} ga a ka a dira tshitshinyo epe e ntšha ya go rekisiwa.

offers.reject: Motshameki {player_id} o ne a gana tshono ya go mo rekolola.
offers.accept: Player {acceptor_id} o amogelesege thebe ya tshwaro go tswa go Player {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} o file tshwaro eno go Player {opponent_id}: Dithoto tse di oferweng: {offered} -> Dithoto tse di hlatlogwang: {requested}

outcome.win: Player {winner_id} won by having a larger gain in inventory value.
outcome.draw: Diphetogo tse di tshwanang mo boleng jwa dithoto tsa batshameki botlhe.
